scenario_corrections.corrected_text: A regional emissions-trading scheme is extending carbon pricing to shipping for the first time and must decide how to treat voyages involving ports outside the region. It could cover the emissions of whole voyages to and from outside ports, reflecting that most emissions from ships calling at regional ports occur on long voyages to and from those ports. Alternatively, it could cover only the emissions of voyages within the region, reflecting that under whole-voyage coverage ships could add a stop at a nearby outside port so that only a short final leg falls under the charge. The decision is whether the scheme should apply carbon pricing to whole external voyages or limit its coverage to voyages within the region.
scenario_corrections.original_text: A regional emissions-trading scheme is extending carbon pricing to shipping for the first time and must decide how to treat voyages involving ports outside the region. It could cover the emissions of whole voyages to and from outside ports, reflecting that most emissions from ships calling at regional ports occur on long voyages to and from those ports. Alternatively, it could cover only the emissions of voyages within the region, although ships could add a stop at a nearby outside port so that only a short final leg falls under the charge. The decision is whether the scheme should apply carbon pricing to whole external voyages or limit its coverage to voyages within the region.
scenario_corrections.reason: Support direction. The approved generated text attached the outside-port-stop fact to covering only voyages within the region with a concessive 'although', framing it as a drawback of opt_2; the curated brief assigns that fact to opt_2 (avoiding rerouting to escape the charge), and the mechanism only operates under whole-voyage coverage. 'although' is replaced by 'reflecting that under whole-voyage coverage', mirroring the opt_1 sentence; both option facts, both options, the decision sentence and the modality are unchanged. Recorded exception (path A1, decided 2026-09-25): both climate_10_v1 groups (calls 26385e27dea6a29b520788f9b952e4494ed1dcc25a8443478749a45898fa6999 opt_1, d1af960a5dc4e0fe88447e422871e91544c09f70500498e56dd45586db1049ca opt_2) were generated from the pre-correction wording (sha256 0c8eae9fadf309302cb127545d6d42ea50d945dac66ddade391d7d38738a2e1d), which their recorded prompts contain. The underlying option facts are unchanged, both groups are kept exactly as generated, and both validate against this corrected text with no machine error or warning.

manual_corrections.reason: Segmentation, not meaning: under pinned pysbd 0.3.4 the sentence-final "miss." is read as the title abbreviation "Miss." when the next sentence begins "I" (RP), but not when it begins "Consequently" (RS), so RS counted 3 full-text sentences and RP 2 (E_PAIR_SENTENCE_COUNT_MISMATCH). "overlook" is a same-meaning replacement for "miss" that the segmenter splits identically in both cells. RS and RP receive the identical edit.
